state: Final implementation candidate; complete fresh gate and integration pending. Notes and historical correction recovery, truthful receipts and supporting-record links implemented; no P07 closure or new Debug drop claimed.
problem: Completed notes lost raw authored text after closing and reopening following a refused Save. Completed receipt copy omitted its captured date and exact elapsed seconds; record bests did not link to their exact supporting session.
baseline: baseline-notes02 reproduces reopened Saved note instead of the raw authored text while the confirmed database note remains unchanged. baseline-notes01 was a fixture collector timeout and is retained separately.
concept: Connected compact receipt, complete recorded values and sources, correction, retained raw notes, Retry/Keep/Discard and truthful missing/read-failure states. history-preparation/details-receipts-concept.html was shown before coding; browser simulation is not Android evidence.
decision: Preserve existing completed-training capabilities and calculations; add private raw checkpoints and frozen note commands, exact reconciliation and narrowly guarded completed-note CAS. Resolve record links from the exact supporting set and store; use captured activity day and exact elapsed seconds alongside existing whole-minute summary.
tradeoff: Durable Keep must complete before an orderly exit promises preservation. Conflicting/orphan drafts remain selectable and privately retainable, but do not authorize overwriting/recreating saved records. Explicit Discard affects private unfinished text only.
behavior: Separate owner-keyed fields and commands; ordered maintenance/private IO and claim/version/generation fencing. Existing SavedState complements durable storage.
Private command admitted before business writes; exact saved outcome settles without replay, unchanged baseline may retry, unavailable/conflicting data retains authored text.
Latest raw fields survive older accepted writes; confirmed cleanup never replays a completed Save. Close/Back retain, Discard clears only unfinished work.
Completed strength and typed activity notes preserve their original stores/IDs. Activity snapshot set repair and repeat remain refused under the accepted capability contract.
Receipt shows captured activity date, exact seconds/hours and recorded distance without changing stored values or minute calculations.
Best-record links require exact set/session/values/time and unambiguous store. Full names/dates wrap; bodyweight repetitions do not invent zero-kilogram records.

Historical set checkpoint/admission foundation retains original identity/time/values, raw numeric text and captured units; real repository CAS and exact-readback reconciliation preserve corrections. Production private-generation fencing stays enabled, and unreadable private checkpoints permit explicit private-only Discard.

Historical editor restores raw numeric text with its captured entry unit, reserves and retains immutable pending commands, keeps Close/Review private fields, and exposes Resume/Read again/private Discard for missing or conflicting saved rows. The shipping ViewModel reconciles framework and private identities before discarding unfinished work.

Reconstruction prefers readable durable notes over an older Android snapshot. Same-visit live text remains authoritative after failed Keep and Read again; framework raw is a fallback when no private text exists.

Conflicting set editors show literal retained values and reachable recovery instead of opening a keypad whose owner refuses input. Confirmed private Discard reopens the owner before admitting edits, or shows actionable Read again after an unavailable read.

The numeric-entry interface requires each owner to implement input admission explicitly. Conflicting historical editors show recovery once, with quiet secondary actions and no redundant Resume while already open.
